title: Evaluation of a Boolean literal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be an index among $n$ variables, let $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to those variables. The literal at index $i$ with polarity $b$ evaluates to true if and only if $x(i)=b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a Boolean assignment to the $n$ variables
